text: This report recommends that the name "Lucie Tuch Lane" be approved to identify a public lane in block bounded by Harbord Street, Markham Street, Ulster Street, and Palmerston Boulevard.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Lucie Tuch Lane" for a proposed public lane in the block bounded by Harbord Street, Markham Street, Ulster Street, and Palmerston Boulevard.
